name: Portfolio Tracker
description: Values a portfolio CSV (symbol, shares, cost_basis) at current prices, records today's total in a history file so a trend builds up over time, and writes a report with totals, positions, trend and a factual commentary. Read-only: no trading and no advice. Inputs: portfolio_path, source (yahoo or simulated), history_path, report_path.

task.instruction:
Restate these portfolio facts as 3 to 4 plain sentences. Copy each name and number exactly as written below; do not work anything out yourself.
Cover: the total value and today's change; the largest position and its weight; the best and worst performer versus cost (the 'Best / worst vs cost' line); and the trend sentence.
Do not predict, give opinions or give advice, and do not suggest buying, selling or holding anything.

<totals>
{{valued.totals_text}}
</totals>

<trend>
{{trend.summary}}
</trend>
